title: Saving Water at Home
text:
Water is very important for life, but we often waste it. A person can leave the tap open while brushing teeth. This wastes many liters of water every day. Small changes can help us save water at home.

Our family started a new habit last year. We take short showers and we fill a bucket to water the plants. Now we use less water each month. My grandmother says that saving water is a good way to help the future.

questions.text: What can a person do that wastes many liters of water?
options: Leave the tap open while brushing teeth
Water the plants with a bucket
Drink a small glass of water

questions.text: What does the family use a bucket for?
What can we infer about the narrator's family?
options: They want to use less water
They do not care about the environment
They have no plants at home
They take long showers every day

questions.text: What can be inferred about the narrator's grandmother?
options: She thinks saving water helps the future
She does not live with the family

vocabulary.definition: to use something in a careless way, so that it is lost
something you do regularly, often without thinking
a round container with a handle, used to carry water
the time that is still to come

paragraph_translations: El agua es muy importante para la vida, pero a menudo la desperdiciamos. Una persona puede dejar el grifo abierto mientras se lava los dientes. Esto gasta muchos litros de agua cada día. Pequeños cambios nos pueden ayudar a ahorrar agua en casa.

Nuestra familia empezó un nuevo hábito el año pasado. Nos duchamos rápido y llenamos un cubo para regar las plantas. Ahora usamos menos agua cada mes. Mi abuela dice que ahorrar agua es una buena forma de ayudar al futuro.
